method: Web search for the acquirer's or administrator's own announcement, read on this Mac (network open). Where a primary page refuses automated readers (Snowflake's blog answers 403 behind Cloudflare), the search index's title and date for that exact URL are recorded and the refusal is stated, never hidden.

companies.finding: CLOSED. Snowflake's own post 'Snowflake Closes Acquisition of Observe to Bring AI-Powered Observability to Customers' is dated 2026-02-02 (search index; page 403 to automated fetch). The registry had the 2026-01-08 'intent to acquire' release as its only evidence and that date as 'effective'.
companies.change: effective 2026-01-08 -> 2026-02-02; close post linked first, intent release kept

companies.finding: ANNOUNCED Aug 2025 by Databricks ('Tecton joining Databricks'); Fenwick (Databricks' counsel) describes it as an acquisition of Tecton's ASSETS. No separate closing release was found. On 2026-11-09 the product's fetcher followed tecton.ai to www.databricks.com (domain_verification.json); on 2026-11-26 a plain request to tecton.ai answers 403, so the redirect was not re-observed today. So the company no longer publishes as itself, which is what the status page needs.
companies.bounded_because: no closing announcement located; the absorption is evidenced by the announcement plus the redirect, not by a close notice

companies.finding: CONFIRMED. Administrator Interpath: Cervest ceased trading, 71 staff made redundant, certain intangible assets sold to Mitiga Solutions SL on 2023-06-25. Mitiga's own release dated 2023-07-05 announces the IP purchase. The cloud pass's 'link is Mitiga's homepage' was a LABEL defect: the href was already the press release, but the visible text was the bare host.
companies.change: status-page link labels now carry the document headline (webapp.app.announcement_label); no data change

companies.finding: ANNOUNCED 2025-02-13 on HiBob's own newsroom; reported subject to closing conditions at announcement, no separate close notice found. Mosaic now ships inside HiBob as 'Bob Finance' (secondary: Sacra). Measured 2026-11-26: https://mosaic.tech and https://www.mosaic.tech both redirect to https://www.hibob.com/platform/finance/ (the Nov 9 fetch of mosaic.tech failed and recorded no redirect).
companies.bounded_because: close inferred from the product's absorption and the redirect, not from a close notice
